threat_or_failure_scenario: Forged actor or stale authority accesses another employee's records
existing_safeguards: Signed JWT; server role reload; actor matching; scoped records
evidence_basis: A501/A502/A510/A511/A516; E1 secure suite; E2 C-01
control_gaps: Real Auth/subject map and normal UI sign-in unverified
recommended_mitigation: Provision reviewed mapping; test actual sign-in in isolated staging

threat_or_failure_scenario: Operator exposes main:app with client-chosen actors
existing_safeguards: Separate secured factory and loopback-only guidance
basis_type: Known source configuration; external exposure hypothetical
recommended_mitigation: Deployment command must select authenticated factory; deny external compatibility access; verify deployment

threat_or_failure_scenario: Confidential text reaches unintended recipient or AI provider
existing_safeguards: Participant/owner privacy; metadata-only oversight; safe errors
basis_type: Executed access tests; provider disclosure hypothetical
control_gaps: No validated data classification/DLP/provider agreement or production TLS
recommended_mitigation: Classify data; minimize prompts/logs; privacy and provider review; test redaction

threat_or_failure_scenario: Missing Messages route prevents follow-up; unsafe replacement could widen access
existing_safeguards: Clarification participant guards and reply/resolve rules
evidence_basis: A510; E2 browser MSG-001; E4 Assignment 4
basis_type: Known missing route; executed clarification tests
recommended_mitigation: Approve scoped Messages contract; implement with participant and negative tests in separate change

threat_or_failure_scenario: High lexical score or latest version gives incomplete guidance
existing_safeguards: Approved-policy filter; confidence/keyword gate; reference IDs; human-review notice
evidence_basis: A503/A513/A517; original nine incident tests; E4 SEARCH_SQL
basis_type: Executed deterministic/local tests; semantic accuracy unverified
control_gaps: No version-level approval/effective gating; no PostgreSQL or legal-accuracy validation
recommended_mitigation: Validate retrieval against isolated PostgreSQL and reviewed corpus; require approved/effective version selection design

threat_or_failure_scenario: Unanswered request remains open without notification or deadline
existing_safeguards: Assigned clarification; status and resolution records
evidence_basis: E4 Assignment 4; models.py; existing secured reply tests
basis_type: Code inspection and executed privacy workflow; delay hypothetical
recommended_mitigation: Adopt internal queue reviews; define owner/backup and test overdue escalation later
target_or_review_timeframe_proposed: Proposed daily review after SOP approval

threat_or_failure_scenario: Publication or state change cannot be attributed from immutable history
existing_safeguards: Admin-only publication; policy versions; source/evidence hashes
evidence_basis: E1 secure policy tests; E4 Assignment 4
control_gaps: No approved_by/at or append-only actor/action transition events
recommended_mitigation: Approve audit-event design in section 12; test atomicity and access before migration

threat_or_failure_scenario: Required records are deleted or retained excessively
existing_safeguards: Existing relational records and dated evidence files
control_gaps: No approved retention schedule, hold, disposal or restore-tested evidence repository
recommended_mitigation: Legal review record classes; approve periods/holds/access and test restore/disposal controls

threat_or_failure_scenario: Trusted-host article is outdated, altered or inapplicable to the bank
existing_safeguards: Closed source registry; per-source cache/stale indicators; URL restrictions
evidence_basis: E2 C-03 55/55; Pulse integrity 22/22; E5 source-access status
basis_type: Reused executed synthetic tests; live fetching blocked
control_gaps: Live redirects/currency and legal applicability not verified; article destinations not all probed
recommended_mitigation: Restore approved network access; verify official text; record relevance/applicability decision and reviewer
target_or_review_timeframe_proposed: P1 before relying on Pulse item

threat_or_failure_scenario: Wrong entry point, proxy or transport exposes confidential traffic
existing_safeguards: Explicit entrypoint documentation; secure assembly; isolated local-only demo
basis_type: Executed local tests; future deployment hypothetical
recommended_mitigation: Review exact deployment command; test TLS/proxy/host controls and real auth in isolated staging

threat_or_failure_scenario: Invalid state, unauthorized escalation or failed reference lookup disrupts response
existing_safeguards: State-pair validation; admin escalation/closure; safe lookup-before-insert; manual reporting fallback
basis_type: Executed API/state tests; outage operational impact hypothetical
control_gaps: No immutable transitions, SLA timers, resolved_at or automatic notifications; lookup outage blocks intake
recommended_mitigation: Approve SOP; exercise alternate intake; design audit history; PostgreSQL and concurrency tests

threat_or_failure_scenario: Dashboard misleadingly counts resolved cases or null feedback and lacks trend evidence
existing_safeguards: Existing count/group aggregates and role-limited governance view
evidence_basis: E1 governance access test; E4 Assignment 4 metrics
basis_type: Executed role/basic total tests; source-inspected metric gaps
control_gaps: UI queue sums all incident statuses; null feedback shown 0%; decorative bars; no reporting period/trend
recommended_mitigation: Reuse dashboard; approve metric definitions and edge-case tests; fix presentation separately
